PCBA_03.name: Universal Smart Cartridge Pod Interface
PCBA_03.architecture_notes: Symmetric Cartridge hardware. Bay ID (Pod 1 Left vs. Pod 2 Right) configured via NVS / Hub enumeration. Dual-mode audio interface via U4 (TS5A23157 Dual SPDT) controlled by OMM_DETECT (J4.6). Mode 0 (OMM_DETECT HIGH / Sena): Dual pins J4.4/J4.5 route to ES8388 LIN1/RIN1, J4.7 is Mic Out, J4.8 is PTT. Mode 1 (OMM_DETECT LOW / OMM): Dual pins J4.4/J4.5 route to U7 (CH554E USB Host) UDP/UDM, communicating with ESP32-C6 via 2 Mbps UART (GPIO20 TX / GPIO21 RX).
